added.summary: -og-burst in a keyframe takes var() and calc(): -og-burst: 21 var(--size-4xl) var(--gold) var(--motion-duration-breathe). Each animated element resolves the value through its own cascade, so two elements with different custom properties throw different bursts from one @keyframes; a value that is not a count, a radius in px, a colour and a time once resolved fires nothing and is reported. A literal value is read as before.

An <anchor mass>'s keyframes take var() and calc() in translate, scale and opacity (translate: 0 calc(var(--space-3xl) * -1)), resolved through the anchor's cascade; such a keyframe was dropped from the element's timeline before. The built-in damage numbers rise again as they fade, and the celebration's fireworks shells throw their rays again.
